### Hi, I'm Artur 👋

**Senior Infrastructure & Systems Engineer** · [HBF MANAGEMENT](https://hbf.pl) · Katowice, Poland

I build and run infrastructure that is meant to behave predictably — from small company networks to enterprise platforms and large-scale migrations. 25+ years in IT, with a strong bias towards infrastructure as code, repeatable deployments, monitoring and documentation the next person can actually use.

- ☁️ Led a **~900 VM on-premises → AWS migration**, with Terraform and Ansible standardising provisioning and configuration
- 🐘 **8+ years administering enterprise Big Data** platforms — HPE Ezmeral / MapR, Cloudera, Hadoop, YARN, Spark
- 🛠️ Designed a reusable **Ansible framework** (roles, structured inventories, standardised playbooks) for contact-center deployments
- 🏢 Built and ran the **complete IT environment of a licensed casino** — network, servers, endpoints, IAM, backup, monitoring
